segments.title: March
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! March is Main Character Month. Women's Day, Holi, and a whole studio full of people who deserve the spotlight. This month we hand it to them, and gently suggest they renew while standing in it.

segments.title: ₹7.13L
segments.text: So, the number. Our March target for Kenkere House is 7.13 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent up on last March. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 3.78 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 2.42 lakh, everything else 49,900, and comebacks 42,800. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 36 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 536 leads, 193 trials, and 36 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.

Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 5.35 lakh rupees, which is 75 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: The Second Date's On Us
segments.text: First up, for newcomers, The Second Date's On Us. First class at half price, the second one free, and the third? That's a relationship, with fifteen per cent off the first month and an extra freeze. The plan is 17 buyers at about 12,400, so 2.11 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai
segments.text: Next, for Holi, Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai. A forty-eight hour window for members expiring in March. Three months at fifteen per cent off and a limited Holi tee. Colours wash out. Abs don't. The plan is 5 buyers at about 35,900, so 1.79 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Monogamy Is Overrated
segments.text: And finally, Monogamy Is Overrated. Renew this month and we pay for two classes in formats you've never tried. Members who play the field stay longer. That's data, not gossip. The plan is 11 buyers at about 13,100, so 1.44 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: No price discount; ≈17% value on a 12-class pack, ≈16% on 1M if the bonus is earned

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, Holi, and the forty-eight hour renewal window opens. Week three, nudge every member who has only tried one format. Week four, no March expiry leaves without a conversation.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's March at Kenkere House. 7.13 lakh rupees, three offers, and 36 buyers to welcome. Everyone gets to be the main character. Our job is the plot.
